//: Settings the modules read, for the hosts' user secrets (bjk-core, bjk-identity-server). Copy the sections a host needs into its own user-secrets.template.json. Locally these values are for development only; in Azure they come from Key Vault and container settings.

Safety.//: RequireAgeVerification defaults to true (write endpoints need the age_verified claim). Set false only for local development and tests, until the identity server's age check is running locally.

Posts.//: Where incidents may be posted: GB (the UK, the default when empty), IM (Isle of Man), JE (Jersey), GG (Guernsey).

Screening.//: Keywords (default) uses the built-in list only. Http adds a classifier service (e.g. Detoxify in a sidecar): POST {"text"} -> {"scores": {...}}.

Captcha.//: Same keys as the identity server. Cloudflare's test secret below accepts every token (clients send XXXX.DUMMY.TOKEN.XXXX). Provider AlwaysPass skips the check entirely (tests only).

Messaging.//: Shared RabbitMQ settings (see bjk-core's template for ConnectionUri). MediaEventsQueue is the API host's queue for media.ready / media.failed, which publish posts made while their media were processing.

Media.//: Defaults shown; set only to change them. Limits since 19 Oct 2026: videos 30 s and 150 MB (157286400 bytes), photos 25 MB.

Processing.//: Worker only. Videos longer than SegmentSeconds are split into segment jobs processed in parallel by several replicas (0 = never split). FfmpegThreads 0 = every core of the replica. Keep MaxConcurrentJobs at 1 (one job per replica) and scale replicas.

Redaction.//: Worker only. Video frames are analysed at most DetectionMaxSize px (0 = full size). InferenceThreads 0 = every core. ExecutionProvider Cpu; Cuda only on a GPU worker image built with Microsoft.ML.OnnxRuntime.Gpu.
